set.reason: Standard SMR with endometriosis as outcome; no gene passed SMR plus HEIDI (CDC42 failed HEIDI). Null paper, 0 claims.

why: Paper's standard SMR uses endometriosis (Sapkota 2017) as outcome, so it is eligible; by its own criteria no gene is claimed. Excluding it as E3 would hide a null result.

set.notes: Reported IVW beta -0.000169123 (SE 8.36e-05); OR and CI converted here as exp(beta), exp(beta +/- 1.96 SE). Betas are implausibly small for log-odds per SD expression; scale uncertain. MVMR (Table 5) OR 0.9813 (0.9705-0.9923), p 0.00086. Instruments p<5e-8, clump r2 0.001 within 10 kb, >=3 SNPs; 40 of 49 candidate genes analysed; no multiple-testing correction. Outcome cohort mapping assumes GCST90018839 = Sakaue 2021 European UKB+FinnGen meta (not described in paper; verify). [Lead correction 2026-10-29: outcome GWAS not stated in paper; extractor assumption of Sakaue 2021 removed]

why: Extraction rules forbid inferring the outcome source; the extractor reported it was assumed.

set.notes: Abstract only. Direction inferred from abstract/title mediation statement (HLA-DRA inhibits CREB3L4 expression, which increases risk), i.e. lower CREB3L4 -> higher risk; abstract does not state CREB3L4's own MR estimate or whether it passed Bonferroni. [Lead correction 2026-10-29: direction was inferred from a mediation statement, no estimate reported]

why: Direction must come from the paper, not inference.

set.notes: PD-L1 (programmed cell death 1 ligand 1) not named in the protein results but used as a mediator, so it is among the 6 significant proteins; both positive proteins are named (IL-17A, CDCP1), so direction inferred protective. Sixth significant protein unnamed in text. 91 proteins tested; nominal P<0.05 (IVW), no correction; 6 significant, text gives values for 4. IV threshold stated (P<5e-5, r2<0.001, 10,000 kb) for lipid/immune exposures; protein threshold not stated. Controls in Table S1. [Lead correction 2026-10-29: direction inferred; protein used as mediator, no estimate reported]

why: Direction must come from the paper, not inference.

set.notes: Abstract only (ScienceDirect and RBMO pages returned 403; no PMC copy). 'Genetic mimicry in PCSK9' OR for endometriosis stages 1-2; abstract gives no P, lipid trait used for weighting, outcome GWAS, or whether the exposure is scaled as lipid-lowering or raising. Conclusion favours lipid-lowering drugs, suggesting OR per unit higher lipid via PCSK9 variants (direction must be verified in full text). Abstract says SMR and colocalisation were run for significant targets; results not given. Overall-endometriosis estimate not in abstract. [Lead correction 2026-10-29: abstract does not say whether exposure is target lowering or raising]

why: Direction must come from the paper, not inference.
